title: Personal Services Plan — Terms for Suspending a Package during an Absence
content:
A Personal Services Plan package may be put on hold for whole calendar months while the resident is away. The terms of a suspension are these.

## Terms in force

1. **Grounds.** A package may be suspended for whole calendar months while the resident is away from the community for at least the tier's minimum absence days, for a hospital, rehabilitation or extended family stay.
2. **Notice.** A suspension must be requested no later than the tier's suspension notice days before the first suspended month.
3. **Counting the notice.** The notice is counted in calendar days back from the first day of the first suspended month, so the last day to request is that first day less the suspension notice days in calendar days, inclusive. The first day of the first suspended month is the one recorded for the suspension.
4. **During the suspension.** No package fee is charged and no hours are granted, and hours left at the start of the suspension expire at the end of the month before it.
5. **Resumption.** The plan resumes on the first day of the month after the last suspended month, with that month's fee and allotment.

## Retired clause

> Retired wording, no longer in force and superseded by the current basis: "Suspended months in any rolling 12 months, counting the plan's suspensions recorded and the months requested, may not exceed the tier's maximum suspended months per rolling 12 months; the Pay-As-You-Go Plan has nothing to suspend."

## Notice boundary (7 calendar days on every tier)

For a hypothetical suspension whose first suspended month begins on 1 June:

| Request signed on | Calendar days before 1 June | In time? |
|---|---|---|
| 24 May | 8 | Yes |
| 25 May | 7 | Yes — the last day to request, inclusive |
| 26 May | 6 | No |

## Hypothetical illustration of terms 4 and 5

A package suspended for June and July: hours left on the plan at the start of the suspension expire at the end of May; no fee is charged and no hours are granted for June or July; the plan resumes on 1 August with August's fee and allotment.

superseded_clauses: Suspended months in any rolling 12 months, services_msr_suspended_months_12m including the months requested, may not exceed max_suspension_months_per_12m of the package; the Pay-As-You-Go Plan has nothing to suspend.
